# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from odoo.tests import tagged
from odoo.tests.common import TransactionCase


@tagged('post_install', '-at_install')
class TestLibraryManagementSmoke(TransactionCase):
    def test_models_registered(self):
        Model = self.env['ir.model']
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_branch')], limit=1))
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_author')], limit=1))
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_book')], limit=1))
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_loan')], limit=1))
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_reservation')], limit=1))
        self.assertTrue(Model.search([('model', '=', 'x_lib_fine')], limit=1))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from odoo.tests import tagged
from odoo.tests.common import TransactionCase


@tagged('post_install', '-at_install')
class TestLibraryManagementWorkflow(TransactionCase):
    def test_header_status_field(self):
        Model = self.env['x_lib_book']
        self.assertIn('x_status', Model._fields)
        rec = Model.new({'x_name': 'Elite workflow probe'})
        rec.x_status = 'draft'
        self.assertEqual(rec.x_status, 'draft')
